grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。
title: Daily Routines and Habits
instructions: 听录音，完成8个问题。录音会播放两遍。请仔细听，答案必须来自录音内容。
transcript: A: Hi, I'm Li Ming. I'm a student. I get up at six thirty every day. I have breakfast at seven. I walk to school. I have four classes in the morning. I have lunch at twelve. In the afternoon, I have two classes. I go home at five. I do my homework at seven. I go to bed at ten. What about you? B: I'm Wang Fang. I get up at seven. I have breakfast at seven thirty. I go to work by bus. I work from nine to five. I have lunch at twelve thirty. I go home at six. I have dinner at seven. I watch TV at eight. I go to bed at eleven.

questions.explanation: 录音中李明说：'I get up at six thirty every day.' 所以起床时间是6:30。
questions.evidence: I get up at six thirty every day.

questions.explanation: 录音中李明说：'I walk to school.' 所以他是步行去学校。
录音中王芳说：'I go to work by bus.' 所以她是坐公交车上班。
questions.evidence: I go to work by bus.

questions.explanation: 录音中王芳说：'I have lunch at twelve thirty.' 所以午饭时间是12:30。
questions.evidence: I have lunch at twelve thirty.

questions.explanation: 录音中李明说：'In the afternoon, I have two classes.' 所以下午有两节课。
questions.evidence: In the afternoon, I have two classes.

questions.explanation: 录音中王芳说：'I have dinner at seven.' 所以晚饭时间是7点。
录音中李明说：'I do my homework at seven.' 所以做作业时间是7点。
questions.evidence: I do my homework at seven.

questions.explanation: 录音中王芳说：'I go to bed at eleven.' 所以睡觉时间是11点。
questions.evidence: I go to bed at eleven.

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I/you/we/they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，动词用原形，不需要加 -s 或 -es。例如：I get up at six. You walk to school. We have lunch at twelve. They go home at five.
grammar.example: I get up at six thirty every day.

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 get，所以 'I get up at six.' 正确。
questions.evidence: I get up at six thirty every day.

questions.explanation: 主语是 you，动词用原形 walk，所以 'You walk to school.' 正确。
主语是 we，动词用原形 have，所以 'We have lunch at twelve.' 正确。
主语是 they，动词用原形 go，所以 'They go home at five.' 正确。

part1: What time do you get up?
What do you have for breakfast?
How do you go to work or school?

speaking.part2: Describe your daily routine. You should say:
part3: Do you think it is important to have a daily routine?
How do you plan your time?
